ADA 2025 Section 11 also read: 'The Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) creatinine equation was refit without the race variable and should be used for everyone.' Implementation caution: Scr in the equation is in mg/dL; laboratories reporting µmol/L need a unit conversion before κ is applied. The ARK study (REF-DM-VAL-EGFR-ARK) found this equation overestimates kidney function in Uganda.
